Prescribed dose

A dose rate may auto-fill from your uploaded table. Verify it for the patient, species, indication and route before use.

Clinical safety: This tool performs arithmetic only. It does not supply or validate drug doses. Confirm species, indication, route, frequency, maximum dose, formulation, contraindications, interactions and patient-specific factors with a veterinary clinician and an authoritative formulary before administration.

Unit conversions

Calculation formulas

Weight-based dose: body weight (kg) × dose (mg/kg) = total dose (mg).

Volume: required dose (mg) ÷ concentration (mg/mL) = volume (mL).

Tablet amount: required dose (mg) ÷ tablet strength (mg/tablet) = tablets.

Micrograms: 1 mg = 1,000 µg. Always check the concentration label and units.
